failed_tests.name: plan_schema::clean_database_and_schema_18_upgrade_reach_latest_complete_schema
failed_tests.error: Declared pre-existing baseline failure (panicked at crates/r-code-store/tests/plan_schema.rs:245, assertion left == right failed: left 35, right 18): the v18-era simulation strips newer schema objects and DELETEs schema_version rows 19-34, but the current numeric ledger stands at LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION=35 (migrations.rs:14, registry-consistent — the clean-database assert earlier in the same test passes at 35), so the version-35 row survives the DELETE and the expected-18 assertion fails. Same declared baseline as P11; P12 adds only the string-id 'safety-capability-reports' row to the separate v1_schema_migrations ledger and does not bump the numeric version, so this is not a P12 regression. Corrects iteration 1's ledger, which recorded the actual as 36; the fresh iteration-2 measurement is 35.

summary: PASS: 929/930 cumulative (Runtime 392 + Kernel 75 + Store 416/417 + protocol/sdk 33 + codex 13) with quality_pass true — P12 delivers the content-addressed safety capability report store (put/current/history/prune, byte-idempotent regeneration), the timestamp-free SafetyReportMaterial with the fail-closed evaluate_safety_activation predicate, and the redacted local-only safety.report.get diagnostics; nothing activates this wave because P13 owns the probe protocol (Unsupported/SafeDisabled never activate, zero or failing probes stay NotActivated). Iteration 2 fixed the one real defect — prune_safety_reports now upserts the capability head BEFORE deleting the other rows inside the same IMMEDIATE transaction, so the safety_report_heads FK no longer rejects the prune and the previously failing test passes unchanged — and removed the dead safety_activation_summary helper (simplicity now 5). The single remaining failure is the declared pre-existing plan_schema baseline (expects 18, actual 35 = LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION since P11; iteration 1's ledger said 36, corrected here to the measured value), and the fail-fast discovery stands: full-Store counts use --no-fail-fast (417 total) because cargo's default fail-fast undercounted older ledger rows.
